title: Lexicographically Smallest Topological Ordering

constraints.edges: Directed graph with possible duplicate edges.

input_format: The first line contains n and m. Each of the next m lines contains two integers u and v, representing a directed edge from u to v.
output_format: Print the lexicographically smallest valid topological ordering as n integers, or IMPOSSIBLE if the graph contains a cycle.
notes: This task differs from T07 by requiring the smallest lexicographic ordering among all valid topological sorts.
A min-heap is the intended implementation.
